---CRITIQUE Gross Franchise Book Bottleneck---
VERDICT: flag
SCORE: 2
RATIONALE: This is effectively Novy-Marx gross-profits-to-assets crossed with book-to-market — the two most heavily documented value/quality anomalies — and the MIN operator is too thin a wrapper to make the combination novel or informative beyond a standard "profitable value" double sort.

---CRITIQUE Cash-Gated Enterprise Sales Yield---
VERDICT: flag
SCORE: 2
RATIONALE: The binary INDICATOR collapses every below-industry-average cash-return firm to exactly zero, so the short leg is a mass of tied firms defined purely by profitability rather than by sales-to-EV, meaning the realized spread will mostly measure the gate itself and not the stated "value conditional on cash quality" mechanism.

---CRITIQUE Margin-Inflecting Earnings Value---
VERDICT: flag
SCORE: 2
RATIONALE: Same zeroing pathology as the previous proposal — the trend indicator sends all margin-deteriorating firms to a tied zero floor, so the short leg becomes a margin-momentum sort rather than "expensive/low-margin" firms, which contradicts the stated hypothesis; the surviving long leg is also just standard E/P × profitability.

---CRITIQUE Durable-Cash Dividend Value---
VERDICT: accept
SCORE: 3
RATIONALE: The mean-minus-volatility cash-profitability "floor" is a defensible and reasonably fresh sustainability proxy interacted with dividend yield, though the large mass of zero-dividend firms will create heavy ties at the bottom and the short leg will largely be non-payers, so the test should be interpreted as within-payer evidence.

---CRITIQUE R&D-Restored Cash Value---
VERDICT: accept
SCORE: 4
RATIONALE: Internally consistent, correctly handles missing R&D via a zero fill, and the intangible-adjusted-profitability × cash-flow-yield interaction is an economically motivated cross-theme construct that goes beyond a plain quality-value double sort, with the caveat that it partially overlaps the intangible-capitalization literature and industry ranking may absorb much of the R&D adjustment.

---CRITIQUE Expensive Fragile-Margin Penalty---
VERDICT: accept
SCORE: 3
RATIONALE: The MAX construction is logically consistent with the stated negative sign and the "fragility" term adds a genuine second dimension, but it is close to a sign-flipped mirror of the first proposal in this same batch and mixes 3-year mean with 5-year volatility windows without justification, so its incremental information over a simple price-to-sales sort is uncertain.
